subject: Placement visit arrangements
text: I am writing to arrange a visit to discuss the practical requirements for my placement. I have been assigned to your facility, and I need to confirm whether visitors may enter through the main entrance after the morning appointment period. My timetable contains successive commitments, so a long detour to another side would make arrival difficult. Could you confirm the simplest route, any building pass required, and whether I should bring a copy of the letter I received last week? I want to avoid causing disruption to your staff or patients. If a short orientation is necessary, I would be grateful if it could take place before my first working session. I can adapt to your convenience. Please let me know if any security steps must be completed by then.
